notes: Checked 2026-11-05 (WebFetch/WebSearch only). Search budget ran out at ~140 tool calls, so these were NOT re-checked for newer rounds: Hailo, NeuReality, Tabnine, Noma, AI21 (deal outcome), Mentee (closing), Verbit, Pliops. Grades: B = dated press (Globes, Calcalist, TechCrunch, TNW, SecurityWeek, SiliconANGLE, Verdict, kr-asia...), C = company/org own site or paper, D = tracker/Wikipedia/Dealroom. Values in last_round.date use the announcement date when the source shows it, else YYYY-MM. 'growth' = a later-stage round the source does not label A-D. Conflicts kept visible: Wonderful valuation $5B vs $5.5B (Globes headline vs body); Cyera June 2026 $600M (Globes, SecurityWeek) vs $300M (SiliconANGLE); Lasso Series A date rests on one Dealroom page. 'url' = official domain from general knowledge (not fetched); null where unsure. Several 403 pages (BusinessWire, techleap, Bloomberg) were not opened - their URLs appear only as seen in search results. Caution: securityweek.com/zenity-raises-125-million/ (Zenity Series C) was opened successfully, but its slug was inferred before opening rather than taken from a search result; the SecurityWeek topic page is listed beside it. Pages actually opened (numbers read from the page): Wonderful, Decart, Lightricks (Wikipedia), Dream, Zenity, Verbit, Qodo, Cyera, Bria, Prompt Security, Aim Security, NextSilicon, Lasso (Dealroom), Dicta-LM 3.0, D-ID, Gong, AI21 talks (Yahoo). For the other rows (AI21 Series C, Hailo, NeuReality, Speedata, Run:ai, Deci, Qwak, Tabnine, Base44, Hour One, Noma, Irregular, Torq, Vast Data, Aidoc, Lumana, Mentee, Hirundo, Pliops) the figures come from search-result titles and summaries of the cited outlets - the headline amount is in the result title, investor lists and totals are from summaries and may be incomplete. Search-result summaries proved unreliable on prices in the hardware file, so treat summary-only details (investors, totals) as lower confidence.
